title: Project manifests, Standards and the /projects tree
asked: Backfilled from the build queue (done step) (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: Every project has a validated project.manifest.json (project-manifest@1); the build engine never loads or compiles a project without one. Rules live in the Dev Console under Standards. Claude files and shared data sync with the hub at /projects/<name>/{_claude,_data}.
